summary: U.S. GoldMining Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement reducing the size of its at-the-market equity program with H.C. Wainwright (lead agent), Ventum Financial and Stifel, now offering up to $3.2 million of common stock. Cumulative ATM sales total roughly $11.42 million; public float was $33.36 million at a $8.54 reference price. The cap reflects the Form S-3 I.B.6 one-third-of-float limit, leaving $5.22 million available after $5.90 million sold in the trailing year. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and share-price pressure.
